findings.body:
This entry states the tar-stream 2→3 bump included an “API migration in `scripts/pack.js`”, but `scripts/pack.js` is not in the tree at base or head and no call-site edits appear in the diff—only the version range in `package.json` / `package-lock.json` changed.

tar-stream 3 is a major release; if pack/extract usage still follows the v2 API, installs of `^3.1.6` will break at runtime. Either add the real migration (or the missing `scripts/pack.js` changes) to this PR, or rewrite the changelog to describe a version-only bump with no call-site updates.

`tar-stream` is raised from `^2.2.0` to `^3.1.6` (major). The PR framing and changelog say call sites were migrated, but this diff contains no pack/extract or `require('tar-stream')` updates—only the dependency range.

Confirm every consumer of `pack`/`extract`/`entry` is updated for the v3 API before merge, or keep the v2 range until those edits land in the same change.

summary:
## Verdict

Incomplete major dependency bump: the changelog asserts an API migration that is not in this PR.

## Narrative

`tar-stream` moves from `^2.2.0` to `^3.1.6` and the lockfile entry matches `3.1.6`, so the declared version and lock stay aligned. The problem is the migration story. The new `CHANGELOG.md` line says the work included an API migration in `scripts/pack.js`, and the PR description repeats that call sites were migrated. Neither base nor head contains `scripts/pack.js` (or any other JS source), and the only non-doc code change is the version string in `package.json` / `package-lock.json`.

tar-stream 3 is a major release with a different stream stack and pack/extract usage patterns than v2. Shipping only the version bump while documenting a completed migration leaves maintainers with false confidence and, if pack/extract call sites exist outside this minimal tree or land later against v2 APIs, a runtime break on install.

No other contract, security, or lockfile-drift issues showed up in the reviewed files: the lockfile was updated in the same commit as `package.json`.

**Recommendation:** request-changes

verification.reason: CHANGELOG.md claims an “API migration in scripts/pack.js”, but that file is absent at base and head, there is no scripts/ tree, and the diff only bumps tar-stream in package.json/package-lock.json with no call-site edits. The changelog entry is therefore inaccurate.

package.json raises tar-stream from ^2.2.0 to ^3.1.6 and the lockfile follows, but the diff has no pack/extract call-site edits; CHANGELOG claims migration in scripts/pack.js, which is absent at both head and base.
